svg.text: HICS IESH v0.2
Perfboard placement
65 x 70 mm matrix board, 25 x 27 holes at 2.54 mm. Zoned placement and separation rules - not a hole-exact route.
2x20 FEMALE HEADER -> Pi GPIO
SOLDER ON THE UNDERSIDE - it seats down onto the Pi
POWER BUSES +5 V / +3.3 V / GND
three continuous rails, each tied to two Pi GND/supply pins
MCP3208 DIP-16
ALREADY SOLDERED - keep it, do not redo
MQ DIVIDERS R3-R6 + C2 1000uF
analogue: keep at the opposite end from the DHT/I2C lines
I2C BREAKOUT - BMP280 / DS3231 / OLED
shortest possible run; route SDA+SCL side by side with a GND between
R1 / R2 4k7 PULL-UPS
1-Wire + DHT22
C1 100nF
decoupling, right at the ADC
SCREW TERMINALS 14 ways
MAST 8 - SOIL 4 - POWER 2 label every way in indelible pen
64 mm x 69 mm (25 x 27 holes @ 2.54 mm) - the carrier-hat-v1 footprint, so this layout transfers to the real PCB
LAYOUT RULES
1. Analogue apart from digital
MCP3208 and the MQ dividers at one end; DHT22 and I2C at the
other. A switching MQ heater beside an ADC input is a
measurable error.
2. One continuous ground
Bond every ground pad into a single strip and tie it to at
least TWO Pi GND pins. A thin shared return is a classic cause
of fault F2.
3. I2C as short as physically possible
Plus 100 kHz instead of 400 kHz in config.txt. Do NOT add
pull-ups - the Pi 3B+ already has 1k8 on GPIO2/GPIO3.
4. Continuity-check before fitting any IC
Do the header, ground strip and supply rails first, then buzz
every net with the multimeter. A shorted rail on a soldered
board is far less forgiving than on a breadboard.
5. Label every terminal on the board itself
The masking-tape flags on the cardboard build are the reason a
rebuild was needed.
WHAT TO KEEP FROM THE EXISTING BOARD
KEEP
the soldered MCP3208 and its 3.3 V / GND / VREF lines
KEEP
any decoupling already fitted
CUT
every jumper-to-jumper chain between modules - this is fault F2
CUT
bare-wire twists and taped joints on any bus signal
ADD
screw terminals for everything that leaves the box
ADD
the passives on sheet 1 - R1-R6, C1, C2
Generated by scripts/gen_drawings.py. Placement is deliberate; hole-exact routing is left to the physical board, whose MCP3208 is already soldered.
